blocks.text: [A.ORG_1] (the Insurer) insures the home of [A.ORG_2] (the Policyholder) on the terms below.
1.1. The policy covers fire, explosion, water damage and burglary.
2.1. The Insurer pays the full cost of repair or replacement of the insured property.
2.2. The Insurer pays for loss of contents (e.g. furniture, appliances and clothing).
4.1. The Insurer pays within 15 working days after receiving all documents.
